summary: Phase 9 B2 Quotation Lifecycle frontend testing completed. All core features working correctly. Seeded quotation QUO-2026-0001 successfully tested through full lifecycle (sent → accepted → converted to booking BK-0003). Created 2 new quotations (QUO-2026-0002 from form, QUO-2026-0003 from lead). Minor RBAC route protection issue found.

rbac_issues.issue: Driver role can access /app/quotations via direct URL. Page loads but shows 'Gagal memuat' error (backend returns 403). Should redirect or show proper 'Access Denied' message instead.
rbac_issues.impact: Low - Backend RBAC working (403), sidebar hides menu correctly. Only affects direct URL access.
rbac_issues.current_behavior: Page loads with error state when driver accesses directly
rbac_issues.expected_behavior: Redirect to dashboard or show 'Anda tidak memiliki akses' message

action_item_for_main_agent: Add frontend route protection for /app/quotations. When unauthorized user (e.g. driver) accesses the page directly, redirect to /app/dashboard or show a proper 'Akses Ditolak' / 'Anda tidak memiliki akses ke halaman ini' message instead of showing the page with loading error. Consider using a ProtectedRoute wrapper or canAccess check in the route component.
